results.title: Normal scenario: 24/7 virtual tutor draft with teacher review gate

input_facts.prompt: Explain why seasons change using two everyday observations.

results.rationale: Lesson 01 sets our startup's mission around accessible, personalized learning with virtual tutors responding to natural-language prompts. Because prompt_tokens (24) fits inside max_window_tokens (256) and teacher_review_gate is True to inspect non-deterministic first-draft output, serving a tutor first draft is approved.

results.title: Boundary scenario: prompt reaches exact n-token window ceiling (256 == 256)

input_facts.prompt: Explain every line of this recursion helper at the exact 256-token limit.

results.remediation_hint: Reduce prompt_tokens (256) below max_window_tokens (256) to leave room in the expanding token window.
results.rationale: Lesson 01 explains that an LLM accepts n tokens and predicts output tokens one by one in an expanding window, sometimes stopping mid-sentence when context fills up. At the exact boundary prompt_tokens == max_window_tokens (256), zero window headroom remains for generated output tokens, so the prompt must be shortened or split.

results.title: Missing-information scenario: omitted learner level, empty prompt, and missing count
results.error_explanation: Cannot evaluate tutor request: missing or blank required field(s): learner_level, prompt, prompt_tokens.
results.remediation_hint: Provide non-empty strings for 'learner_level', 'learning_goal', and 'prompt', integer token counts, and boolean 'teacher_review_gate'.
results.rationale: Lesson 01 defines the prompt as the natural-language instruction needed before any completion can be generated and warns against ungrounded fabrications. With learner_level, prompt, and prompt_tokens missing, the startup must halt, explain which fields are absent, and wait for a valid follow-up request.
